BLOCKER: AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 acceptance evidence unspecified: affected_files, affected_components, risks all "Not specified" — Gate-1 cannot bind ACs to verifiable surfaces.
AC-4 "One 2.5 on the hardening candidate" is a review-plan step, not an engineering requirement; its inclusion as an AC makes the design non-deterministic and gate-incomparable.
CL-006: no embedded Gate 1.5 findings/dispositions block in the design pack; approval is invalid while any BLOCKER/MAJOR is PENDING.
MAJOR: AC-2 migration/back-compat rule for pre-existing older MATERIAL_CHANGE approvals is not stated (grandfather vs. re-approve vs. fail-closed); without it, rollout may break in-flight reviews.
Guardrail 5 (invariants/ordering) incomplete: only three invariants listed; the approval `at` timestamp ordering invariant lacks an explicit timezone/clock-skew/monotonicity rule.
Guardrail 6: test_matrix lists one test per AC but does not cover the mandated negative cases (older approval, stale/older evidence, non-ancestor head) as distinct fail-able tests.
Guardrail 1/rollback: "Revert the change" with no note on already-emitted gate failures or previously persisted derived docs — no migration-interrupted recovery path.
Guardrail 10 observability: only "Gate stderr/exit"; no distinct metric/log signal per failure code (DERIVED_DOC_STALE, MATERIAL_APPROVAL_ORDER, REVIEW_HEAD_NOT_ANCESTOR) for diagnosis.
AC-1 "cannot carry arbitrary executable content" has no stated content-class rules or allowlist; the invariant only covers generator-freshness, leaving the executable-content half unaddressed.
out_of_scope/affected_files are placeholders, so scope creep and file-level blast radius are not bounded (guardrail 4).
MINOR: contracts.files "docs generated" is ambiguous; the exact generated artifacts and their authority source should be pinned (CL-003 terminology).
performance "bounded" lacks a concrete bound or timeout for the docs generator check.
dependencies list names scripts but no version/owner, so reuse-vs-duplicate detection is not provable.
Recurring MINOR classes (response-body close duplication, query-param-only redaction) are not pre-empted in learnings/guardrails despite CL-008/CL-009 requiring injection at design and coding time.
NIT: learnings/guardrails are terse bullets; expanding each into a checkable statement would make Gate-1.5 scoring deterministic.
rollback "Revert; prior gates unchanged" repeats the AC-level rollback without adding a verification step.
SUMMARY: The design captures the three hardening goals but leaves Gate-1 metadata (files, components, risks, out_of_scope) unspecified and omits the CL-006 Gate-1.5 findings/dispositions block, so approval cannot proceed.
Top risks: unspecified migration rule for older MATERIAL_CHANGE approvals, unaddressed "no executable content" rule beyond generator freshness, and rollback without recovery for already-failed gates.
Recommend: pin affected files, add the negative-test matrix, define the approval ordering/clock rule, and embed Gate-1.5 dispositions before resubmitting.
